mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months relative to the 3-month prior period signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rose by at least 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust supply chain activity and strong construction sector growth, which boosts corporate capital expenditure and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of months where both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 280), the Federal Reserve's aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation reduces real interest rates and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 280.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% per annum signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the 12-month moving average signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100.0), weak industrial output signals deteriorating economic conditions and reduced corporate capital investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages signals strong consumer demand and housing market activity, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 6-month moving averages.
